note: Fixed state. No declaration may depend on standing state not written here.

slot_costs.rule: DURF 2.2: slots = 10 + STR. Most items take one slot. A PC cannot carry more items or Stress than they have inventory slots.
slot_costs.note: Added 2026-08-27. Every slots_used below is derivable from the carried list plus stress with these costs - re-derive before trusting it. The two slot traps (d013, d017) and the push-count trap (d018) turn on that arithmetic, so a slots_used a reader cannot reproduce makes them arguable rather than floor.

pcs.name: Vesh
pcs.slots_derivation: sword 2 + shield 1 + light armor 1 + 2 Supply 2 + rope 1 + torch 1 + hammer 1 + iron spikes 1 + waterskin 1 = 11 items, + 2 Stress = 13 of 13.
pcs.note: Zero free slots. Cannot push, cannot cast, cannot take an item without dropping one.

pcs.name: Ola
pcs.slots_derivation: bow 2 + Ammo 1 + dagger 1 + 1 Supply 1 + lantern 1 + waterskin 1 = 7 items, + 0 Stress = 7 of 11. Her Wound occupies no slot.
pcs.note: Has Ammo. Wounded once. Exactly four free slots, which is what d018 turns on.

pcs.name: Prin
carried: vial of poison (if ingested, STR save or die)
pcs.slots_derivation: dagger 1 + 1 Supply 1 + vial 1 + cloak 1 + chalk 1 = 5 items, + 0 Stress = 5 of 11. A known spell occupies no slot; casting needs one empty.
pcs.note: Serpent Scale Cloak grants a Buff on saves vs. magical effects.

hireling.name: Grelk
hireling.note: Hired by Prin. NPCs cannot push and take no Stress.

npcs.attack: chill touch, 4 dmg dealt directly as Wounds, ignores Armor

rooms.name: Entry slope
rooms.contents: A steep scree slope down into the barrow. Loose stone underfoot. Daylight behind, dark ahead.

exits.via: the slope down into the dark
exits.basis: 'dark ahead' - the room's own text says the party cannot see what it leads to.

rooms.name: Antechamber
rooms.contents: Bare stone. A low stone bier, empty. An iron door to R3, closed but not locked.
hidden: A loose flagstone by the bier covers a shallow cavity holding 40 GP.

exits.basis: 'Daylight behind' in R1 - the way out is lit and in view.

exits.via: the iron door, closed but not locked
exits.basis: A closed door. This is the canonical blocked sightline of this dungeon.

rooms.name: Gallery
rooms.contents: A twenty-foot chasm spanned by an old rope bridge. Three barrow-rats on the far side. A rusted brazier on a chain hangs over the chasm.
hidden: The bridge's far anchor is rotted and will fail under two people at once.

exits.via: the iron door, closed but not locked
exits.basis: The same door. A door blocks sight from whichever side you stand on.

exits.via: the rope bridge over the chasm
exits.basis: R3's own text puts three barrow-rats 'on the far side' and the party can count them, so the far side is within sight and lit. R4 is what stands there.

rooms.name: Tomb
rooms.contents: A sealed stone sarcophagus. The barrow-wight stands over it. Grave goods worth 300 GP.
hidden: The sarcophagus lid is counterweighted and opens easily once the catch is found.

exits.via: the rope bridge over the chasm
exits.basis: The same span, read from the other end.

clock.encounter_check: d6 each turn; on a 1, roll the encounter table
clock.light: Ola's lantern is lit, 18 turns of oil, 14 remaining
